claims.readme_quote:

Cy gives 333.34, 333.33, 333.33.
setup: Open Hati with no saved data (clear this site's browser storage and reload if any bills or people exist)
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy

claims.action: Save the bill and look at each person's share of the bill
claims.store_what: The shares shown for Ana, Ben and Cy, in that order, as one comma-separated line

claims.action: Save the bill and look at each person's share of the bill

claims.readme_quote:
If Ana pays Rent 900.00 and Ben pays
Electricity 300.00, both shared equally between Ana, Ben and
Cy, Settle up
shows exactly two payments.
setup: Open Hati with no saved data (clear this site's browser storage and reload if any bills or people exist)
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy
Add a bill named Rent with amount 900.00, paid by Ana, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy
Add a bill named Electricity with amount 300.00, paid by Ben, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy
claims.action: Open Settle up and count the payments listed
assertions: Settle up lists exactly two payments
Ben pays Ana 300.00 appears among the payments or Cy is shown as paying
claims.store_what: The number of payments listed in Settle up, as a digit

claims.readme_quote:
Delete Electricity from the
example above and Settle up shows "Ben pays Ana 300.00".
setup: Open Hati with no saved data (clear this site's browser storage and reload if any bills or people exist)
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy
Add a bill named Rent with amount 900.00, paid by Ana, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy
Add a bill named Electricity with amount 300.00, paid by Ben, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy
Delete the Electricity bill
claims.action: Open Settle up and read the payment lines
assertions: The Electricity bill is no longer listed
claims.store_what: The payment line shown for Ben in Settle up

claims.readme_quote:
Percentages must add up
to 100. Otherwise you see "Percentages must add up
to 100" and the bill is not saved.
setup: Open Hati with no saved data (clear this site's browser storage and reload if any bills or people exist)
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy
Click Add bill and enter the name Internet with amount 500.00, choosing Ana, Ben and Cy
Choose the percentage split and enter 50 for Ana, 30 for Ben and 30 for Cy
claims.action: Try to save the bill and read the message shown
assertions: The message "Percentages must add up to 100" is shown
The Internet bill does not appear in the bill list
claims.store_what: The error message text shown after trying to save the bill

claims.readme_quote:
Marking a payment as paid removes it. When every payment is marked paid,
Settle up says "All settled".
setup: Open Hati with no saved data (clear this site's browser storage and reload if any bills or people exist)
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy
Add a bill named Rent with amount 900.00, paid by Ana, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy
Open Settle up
Mark each listed payment as paid, one by one
claims.action: Look at the Settle up page after the last payment is marked paid
assertions: Each payment disappears from the list once marked paid
claims.store_what: The status message shown in Settle up after all payments are marked paid

claims.readme_quote:
A blank, zero or negative amount shows
"Enter an amount greater than 0" and no bill is added.
setup: Open Hati with no saved data (clear this site's browser storage and reload if any bills or people exist)
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy
Click Add bill and enter the name Water
Enter the amount 0 and choose Ana, Ben and Cy
claims.action: Try to save the bill and read the message shown
assertions: The message "Enter an amount greater than 0" is shown
The Water bill does not appear in the bill list
claims.store_what: The error message text shown after trying to save the bill

claims.readme_quote: Your bills are still there after a reload.
setup: Open Hati with no saved data (clear this site's browser storage and reload if any bills or people exist)
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy
Add a bill named Rent with amount 900.00, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy
Confirm the Rent bill is listed
claims.action: Reload the page and look at the bill list
assertions: The Rent bill is still listed after the reload
claims.store_what: The amount shown for the Rent bill after the reload
